title: The commit-log tests must isolate the Windows profile
goal: isolate_config in susi-gmcp core tests redirects XDG_CONFIG_HOME but on Windows the config root resolves through APPDATA, so commit_record_accepts_signed_record_and_appends_to_ledger reads the real host commit_log.jsonl (34 entries instead of 1) and the full local gate is red. Set APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA to the temp root too.
